To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cation hexammines are highly potent and selective inhibitors of the magnesium (Mg2+) transporter CorA.

(1) Cation hexaamines and related compounds are potent inhibitors of the Cora Mg2+ transporter; (2) The compounds are highly selective for Cora, as they do not inhibit other Mg2+ transport systems; (3) Cation hexammines are chemically stable and can be used to study the Cora Mg+2 transporter; (4) Cation hexamines are chemically stable, and can be used as a tool to study Cora.
cation hexammines are selective and potent inhibitors of the CorAMg2+ transport system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of selective inhibitors of the bacterial Mg2+ uptake systems.
the development of novel inhibitors of bacterial transporters and receptors.
the development of new chemical tools to probe the structure and function of the CorA and related cation transport systems and the role of these systems in cellular Mg2+ homeostasis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CorA Mg(2+)-translocating transporter is highly specific for the hydrated Mg(2+).
the cation hexammines are highly potent inhibitors of Cora-mediated Mg2+ uptake, and the data presented here are consistent with the notion that the CorA transporter binds the hydrated form of Mg2+.
cation hexammines are highly selective and potent inhibitors of the Cora Mg2+ transporter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cation hexammines are highly potent inhibitors of the Cora Mg2+ transport systems.
the CorA Mg(2+) transporter is inhibited by cation hexaamines.
the CorA Mg transporter binds a fully hydrated Mg ion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cation hexamine compounds are potent inhibitors of the Cora Mg2+ transporter.
the CorA transporter interacts with the cationic form of the metal.
the cation hexammines are highly selective inhibitors of CorA and are not effective inhibitors of MgtB or the PhoPQ receptor kinase.
